npws_visitor_areas.note: NPWS Visitor Area layer. Camping areas only (SubtypeCD 5001) are fetched when this state is built. Day use areas and cemeteries are not. CC BY. The layer has no fee, facility or closure fields.

nsw_suburbs.note: Gazetted suburb and locality boundaries from NSW Spatial Services (Geographical Names Board). Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Town search lists every suburb. A name that is also a PlacePoint city or town is pinned on that official point, not the suburb-polygon centroid. Not fetched during the site build; data/nsw-towns.json is prepared by scripts/fetch_nsw_towns.py.

nsw_place_points.note: PlacePoint layer, NSW Spatial Services, GDA2020. placetype domain DmT_PlaceType: 2 City, 3 Town, 4 Village, 5 Locality, 6 Suburb. Camp pages prefer the nearest City or Town within 40 km, and use the nearest place of any of those types only when no city or town is that close. Creative Commons. © State of New South Wales (Spatial Services, Department of Customer Service). Prepared by scripts/fetch_nsw_towns.py into data/nsw-place-points.json.

npws_alerts_rss.note: NPWS alerts RSS, channel NSW National Parks – Fires, floods and park closures. Fetched when this state is built. A camp is marked closed only where the alert text records a closure of its reserve or of that campground. Other alerts are notes and the status stays check. If the feed is unavailable, status stays check.

npws_reserves.note: NPWS reserve polygons, NSW Spatial Services. reservetype is paired on this layer with classsubtype: 1 NP National Park, 2 NR Nature Reserve, 3 HS Historic Site, 4 RP Regional Park, 5 KC Karst Conservation Reserve, 6 AA Aboriginal Area, 7 SC State Conservation Area. Those class labels are the cadastre ClassSubtype renderer. A camp is matched by point in polygon, then to an RSS item with the same reserve name. Fetched when this state is built.

rfs_fdr.note: NSW RFS fire danger ratings and Total Fire Ban feed. DangerLevelToday and FireBanToday are shown for the fire weather district that contains the camp. Fetched when this state is built. If the feed is unavailable, the line is omitted.

rfs_fire_areas.note: NSW fire weather area polygons. The firearea name matches a district Name in fdrToban.xml (slash spacing ignored). The combined ratings-and-boundaries FeatureServer was not used because its query returns a database error. Fetched when this state is built.

safety_html: Not an official warning service. A camp page can show the NSW RFS fire danger rating and Total Fire Ban status for that camp's fire weather district. It does not republish incident warnings. Always check the NSW Rural Fire Service, NSW SES and the Bureau of Meteorology warnings for New South Wales before you travel. In an emergency call 000.

copy.llms_intro: Preview list of {count} camping areas in New South Wales from the NPWS Visitor Area layer and OpenStreetMap. A camp is closed only where an NPWS alert records a closure. Fees and facilities are omitted where the source does not provide them.
copy.llms_closures: Closures are taken from the NPWS alerts RSS (https://www.nationalparks.nsw.gov.au/api/rssfeed/get) where the alert text closes that reserve or that campground. Other alerts are notes and the status stays check. Fire danger rating and Total Fire Ban status are the camp's fire weather district from the NSW RFS feed https://www.rfs.nsw.gov.au/feeds/fdrToban.xml, placed with the NSW fire area polygons. Do not treat a check status as open. If a feed is unavailable, that part is left off.
copy.footer_attribution: Data and attribution. Camping areas from the NPWS Visitor Area layer (camping areas only), CC BY. That layer does not include fees or facilities, so those are left blank. Closures and alert notes are from the NPWS alerts feed, matched to NPWS reserve polygons (NSW Spatial Services). A camp is marked closed only where that alert records a closure. Fire danger rating and Total Fire Ban status are the camp's district from the NSW RFS fire danger feed, using NSW fire area boundaries. Other campgrounds: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Town search: gazetted suburb and locality boundaries, © State of New South Wales (Spatial Services, Department of Customer Service), Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. The nearest town on each camp page uses the PlacePoint layer's placetype (City or Town, otherwise the nearest place within the published types), Creative Commons, same publisher. For current information go to spatial.nsw.gov.au. Incident warnings are linked, not republished: NSW Rural Fire Service, NSW SES and the Bureau of Meteorology.

faq.q: Does the NPWS Visitor Area layer say if a camp is open?
faq.a: The camping-area points do not include open or closed status, fees or facilities. Fees and facilities stay blank. This preview reads the NPWS alerts feed: a camp is marked closed only where that alert records a closure of the reserve or of that campground. Every other camp stays check. The camp page also shows its NSW fire weather district fire danger rating and Total Fire Ban status from the RFS feed.
